name: Oni Noroi
source:
My name is Midou Sayaka.
I'm a very normal third year high school student, I think...
But whenever I ask my friends "I'm normal right?" They all shake their heads at once.

My grades are very normal.
My looks and height are probably average... I think.
The fortunes I get are always bad.
It's always raining when I go on a trip.
People that I like always end up liking one of my friends instead.

...I might be a little unlucky.

However, I'm always lively, Today I safely arrived at my graduation ceremony.
The university I wanted to go to didn't accept me, but Mom and Dad said it's OK to be free for a year.
From tomorrow I have to study hard! 
Even though I may be unlucky, I'm happy.

I never imagined that I might get caught up in an event that would endanger my life.
An oni and a technique user, as well as a killer. Even in a dream I never thought I could be connected with these kinds of people.

In order to live you need to hate, the Oni said.
You will hate if the people important to you are lost, the Technique User said.

In order to protect the people important to me, what should I do...?

[Translated From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ080091.html]DL Site[/url]]
translation:
我的名字是御堂沙耶香。
我是一个很普通的高三学生，我想…
但每当我问我的朋友“我很正常吧？”众人齐齐摇头。

我的成绩很正常。
我的长相和身高大概都中等吧……我想。
我的运气总是不好。
当我去旅行时，总是下雨。
我喜欢的人最终总是喜欢我的一个朋友。

……我可能有点不走运。

不过，一向活泼的我，今天平安抵达了我的毕业典礼。
我想去的大学没有录取我，但是爸爸妈妈说可以自由一年。
从明天开始我要好好学习！
尽管我可能不幸，但我很高兴。

我没想到我会陷入危及生命的事件中。
鬼与术者，同时也是杀手。即使在梦中我也从未想过我可以和这样的人有联系。

为了生存，你需要仇恨，鬼说。
技术使用者说，如果失去了对你来说重要的人，你会讨厌的。

为了保护对自己重要的人，我该怎么办……？

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ080091.html]DL网站[/url]]
